notes.title: Small bug fixes patch - Road to 1.0
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45417600/7bdaad3708f00e907e00a9c3cdd183e5531592e4.png"]

Hey everyone,



This post is really just a test post on how we want to structure our update-posts in the future. 



We've done some game fixes and need our testers to get to testing again. These fixes include fixes with the map, persistent, and boxes.



That's it for now, be sure to keep an eye out for future updates & dev blogs where we'll go more into detail about all the fixes / finalization changes coming to 1.0!


~Isaac
